purpose: Bound GBA/GBC mining into small evidence-first batches so later agents do not spend context rediscovering scope.

batches.objective: Convert the two source-verified Emerald seeds into formal GBA/GBC opportunity records and bind only directly referenced assets.
outputs: small evidence note/contact sheet only if needed
batches.stop_when: field_action_choreography and environment_effect_primitives are promoted/rejected/needs_evidence with exact provenance

batches.objective: Formalize map previews, timed palette animation, and Deoxys interactive-state presentation from already verified source systems.
outputs: compact evidence only where classification requires it
batches.stop_when: all three FireRed seeds have canonical dispositions

batches.objective: Close the battler-status-overlay seed before broader PMD Red effect mining.
batches.stop_when: status-overlay seed is fully source-backed and classified

batches.objective: Bind selected battle-animation primitive graphics to object IDs/move scripts and retain only distinctive component/technique opportunities.
batches.stop_when: seed artwork/choreography findings are promoted/rejected/needs_evidence and no obvious distinctive primitive remains unbound
forbidden: full directory visual catalog unless binding proves necessary

batches.objective: Compare Ruby against pinned Emerald only on high-value visual subsystems and mine materially unique differences.
batches.stop_when: each target path is marked equivalent/superseded/meaningfully different, and only meaningful deltas have opportunity records

batches.objective: Perform a narrow high-threshold review of battle transitions/effect timing and Pikachu-specific presentation.
batches.stop_when: only genuinely distinctive/non-superseded ideas remain; everything else is reference_only/reject

batches.objective: Validate the separate GBA/GBC pool, then produce combined DS + GBA/GBC ranking without rewriting DS records.
batches.stop_when: no obvious high-value GBA/GBC subsystem remains unexamined and combined ranking is reproducible
